name: academy-monitoring-bot
description: Telegram fitness-log bot: Python ADK agent plus an Apps Script sheet API

scripts.check: node -e "const {execFileSync}=require('node:child_process'),fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path');for(const a of fs.readdirSync('apps')){const d=path.join('apps',a,'src');if(!fs.existsSync(d))continue;for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d).filter(x=>x.endsWith('.js')))execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',path.join(d,f)],{stdio:'inherit'})}"
